card.name: Inside drug names and risk phrasing
card.fires_on: Partway through long drug names such as chlorhexidine, fluticasone and NSAIDs, just before the rest of the name. Also on a few small words (it, can, harm) in sentences about drug effects.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of a long drug name, before the ending.
modes.example: Stain resulting from use of chlor<<hex>>idine gluconate oral rinse does not

modes.label: Words about effects
modes.description: A small word like it, can or harm in a sentence about a drug's effect.

modes.label: Entangle word piece
modes.description: Partway through the word entangled in a non-medical passage.
modes.example: might become<< ent>>angled in larger mesh cover.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated.
